info.title: Acared API v1
info.description:
Versioned Sanctum JSON API for Android/mobile clients. Team-scoped endpoints require X-Team-Slug or X-Team-ID. v1 responses include success/message envelope while preserving data/meta/links/errors keys.

All /api/v1 endpoints except auth/login require Authorization: Bearer <token>. Team-scoped endpoints also require X-Team-Slug or X-Team-ID.

TeamSlug.name: X-Team-Slug
TeamSlug.description: Team slug. Provide this or X-Team-ID for team-scoped endpoints.

TeamId.name: X-Team-ID
TeamId.description: Team ID. Provide this or X-Team-Slug for team-scoped endpoints.

ClinicalRecordRequest.description: Payload varies by record type. Use the records/options endpoint for supported fields.
